Question #: 2.Title: Exam NS0-528 topic 2 question 2 discussion - ExamTopics

content.value: A VMware Administrator needs to restore a VM after a recent server patch update has corrupted the VM operating system.

Question #: 3.Title: Exam NS0-528 topic 2 question 4 discussion - ExamTopics

content.value: Your customer wants to set up a local retention time of at least four months. They also want to protect a week of retention from being deleted by ransomware or rogue administrators.
Which two settings create the correct Snapshot policy to achieve this? (Choose two.)
A. Enable Autonomous Ransomware Protection (ARP) on the volume.
B. Create a Snapshot policy with the weekly Snapshot copy retention time set to 122 days.
C. Create a Snapshot policy with the maximum daily snapshots set to 122.
D. Set the SnapLock retention period for the daily Snapshot copies to 7 days.

Question #: 4.Title: Exam NS0-528 topic 2 question 9 discussion - ExamTopics

content.value: You have created a SnapMirror relationship from your production volume serving SMB/CIFS data to your DR cluster. After two days of updates, you do not see any of the expected snapshots on the secondary volume.
Why is SnapMirror failing to replicate snapshots?
A. The SnapMirror label is missing from the SnapMirror policy on the secondary volume.
B. SnapMirror is not properly licensed.
C. SVM peering is not properly configured.
D. The SnapMirror label is missing from the snapshot policy on the secondary volume.

content.value: Your IT company is using NetApp FlexClone on a two node AFF cluster with 20TB of data to rapidly provision environments for each developer.

B. Distribute the SnapMirror destination volumes evenly across the available aggregates.
C. Enable SnapMirror network compression.
D. Enable Flexclone copies on the DR side.
